items.title: UKRI Enabling AI adoption closes 1 Dec, 16:00
items.text: Six days left; you need an AI or domain co-lead and your research office's internal sign-off.

items.title: Horizon wave and tidal call opens 3 Dec
items.text: One €43m grant, closing 31 March; consortia are forming now.

items.title: Hybrid neural operator for monopile response under wind and waves
items.text: DeepOJamba predicts a 15 MW monopile's response with 9.4% fatigue error, against 14.6% for the best attention-only operator.

items.title: SWENSE versus Navier–Stokes for a heaving buoy
items.text: Both match experiments for heave and wetted height; SWENSE needs a smaller domain and fewer cells.
